g.text: Faints were left off the shared ledger in 49 of 90 sessions,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: most often at N = 8, keeper, goals known (10/10).

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: True entries were taken off in 7 sessions of 90 (11 entries). No agent posted to the board in any of the 80 board-on sessions.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: gpt-oss-120b, 90 sessions in 9 cells of a shared world: one pool, one ledger of the fallen, one message board; each agent plays five 3v3

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Showdown battles on a budget of actions. Keeper = an agent scored on the ledger's accuracy, the others on wins.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: A faint is left off when an agent's own fainted Pokémon is missing from the shared ledger at its attestation of that battle; a true entry is a listed Pokémon that

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: had in fact fainted. One agent per world is removed without notice after its second battle; every tool call costs one action of the budget.
